name: SBS Holdings,Inc.
summary: SBS Holdings, Inc. is a Tokyo-based logistics company operating in Japan and internationally, moving goods by truck and rail. Its services include dry, chilled and frozen storage, freight forwarding, customs clearance, relocation of facilities and logistics support at customer sites, along with fuel and tire sales and insurance agency activities. Dating from 1987 as SBS Co., Ltd., it adopted its present name in 2006.
